text: The Budget Subcommittee for Scarborough Civic Centre will hear public presentations on the 2019 Capital, Operating and Rate Supported Budgets at Scarborough Civic Centre on February 7, 2019 from 6:00 p.m. onwards. At its meeting on January 28, 2019, the Budget Committee established two subcommittees to hear the public deputations on the 2019 Capital, Operating and Rate Supported Budgets at City Hall, North York Civic Centre, Scarborough Civic Centre and Etobicoke Civic Centre, and made appointments to the Subcommittees as follows: 2019 Public Deputation Meetings Name of Subcommittee Members Meeting Dates, Locations and Times Budget Subcommittee for City Hall and North York Civic Centre Consultation Councillor Crawford (Chair) Councillor Carroll Councillor Layton February 7, 2019 City Hall 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; and 6:00 p.m. onwards February 11, 2019 North York Civic Centre 3:00 p.m.…
The Budget Subcommittee for Scarborough and Etobicoke Civic Centre Consultations received for information the public presentations and the communications submitted by members of the public.
